profiles.name: System Troubleshooting
profiles.summary: Track symptoms, test competing hypotheses, and preserve observations while resolving technical incidents.
profiles.situational_schema: An incident hub links reported symptoms, diagnostic tests, event logs, and observed system state.
boundaries: A diagnosis is not permission to intervene.
An event log does not by itself prove cause.

scope_guidance.purpose: Track symptoms, test competing hypotheses, and preserve observations while resolving technical incidents.
exclude_candidates: A diagnosis is not permission to intervene.
An event log does not by itself prove cause.

profiles.name: Procedural Environment
profiles.summary: Document prerequisites, authorized roles, exception handling and conditional process steps.
profiles.situational_schema: A process branches at decision points; execution logs and simulations remain separate.
boundaries: Documented steps do not imply permission to act.
Simulation is not authorized execution.

scope_guidance.purpose: Document prerequisites, authorized roles, exception handling and conditional process steps.
exclude_candidates: Documented steps do not imply permission to act.
Simulation is not authorized execution.

profiles.name: Nature Taxonomy
profiles.summary: Classify living and non-living natural entities with explicit criteria and source references.
profiles.situational_schema: A root category branches into groups, subgroups and specimens, with recorded synonyms.
boundaries: Classification is not causal proof.
One observation does not define the taxonomy.

scope_guidance.purpose: Classify living and non-living natural entities with explicit criteria and source references.
exclude_candidates: Classification is not causal proof.
One observation does not define the taxonomy.

profiles.name: System-State Tracking
profiles.summary: Compare the observed condition of several systems across measurable dimensions.
profiles.situational_schema: Rows represent systems; columns represent observed state dimensions; the timeline is external.
boundaries: A snapshot is not a complete event history.
Desired configuration is not observed state.

scope_guidance.purpose: Compare the observed condition of several systems across measurable dimensions.
exclude_candidates: A snapshot is not a complete event history.
Desired configuration is not observed state.

profiles.name: Employee Follow-Up
profiles.summary: Structure a restricted employee casefile with meeting notes, actions and dated supporting records.
profiles.situational_schema: A casefile links meetings, notes, decisions and separate testimony without collapsing their provenance.
boundaries: A casefile is not an automatic verdict.
Private employee information requires separate access controls and retention policy.

scope_guidance.purpose: Structure a restricted employee casefile with meeting notes, actions and dated supporting records.
exclude_candidates: A casefile is not an automatic verdict.
Private employee information requires separate access controls and retention policy.

profiles.name: Federated University / Campus
profiles.summary: Federate separately owned institution, pathways and courses with stable links and explicit course boundaries.
profiles.situational_schema: Institution references pathways; pathways reference independent course states.
boundaries: A campus index does not own the logical content of courses.
An LMS publication requires an independently approved integration.

scope_guidance.purpose: Federate separately owned institution, pathways and courses with stable links and explicit course boundaries.
exclude_candidates: A campus index does not own the logical content of courses.
An LMS publication requires an independently approved integration.

profiles.name: Moodle Learning Publication
profiles.summary: Prepare educational content and mappings for external Moodle integration without automatic transfer or publication.
profiles.situational_schema: Mapping of course identities, learning units and outcomes to LMS resources.
boundaries: A design profile cannot install or publish Moodle activities.
A course state does not confer a teacher or LMS administrator role.

scope_guidance.purpose: Prepare educational content and mappings for external Moodle integration without automatic transfer or publication.
exclude_candidates: A design profile cannot install or publish Moodle activities.
A course state does not confer a teacher or LMS administrator role.

profiles.name: Traditions and Mythology Collection
profiles.summary: Collect and compare sourced traditions while preserving each community attribution and its own context.
profiles.situational_schema: Independent traditions are indexed and cross-referenced without collapsing distinct beliefs.
boundaries: Comparisons do not assert religious equivalence or objective truth.
Do not include nonpublic, initiatory or restricted cultural knowledge without authorization.

scope_guidance.purpose: Collect and compare sourced traditions while preserving each community attribution and its own context.
exclude_candidates: Comparisons do not assert religious equivalence or objective truth.
Do not include nonpublic, initiatory or restricted cultural knowledge without authorization.

profiles.name: Contextual Social Organizations
profiles.summary: Map roles, responsibilities, resources and institutions across socially and historically situated contexts.
profiles.situational_schema: Layers connect roles, institutions and resources over dated and sourced relationships.
boundaries: A descriptive social model must not speak for communities.
Norms and roles are context dependent and not universal.

scope_guidance.purpose: Map roles, responsibilities, resources and institutions across socially and historically situated contexts.
exclude_candidates: A descriptive social model must not speak for communities.
Norms and roles are context dependent and not universal.

profiles.name: Long-Proof Landmarks and Junctions
profiles.summary: Navigate extensive mathematical proofs using endpoints, intermediate junctions, proof references and open frontiers.
profiles.situational_schema: A sparse route graph links proof landmarks and open areas, not formal proof derivations.
boundaries: Navigation shortcuts are not proof steps or certified theorems.
Never mark an open problem solved from a route landmark.

scope_guidance.purpose: Navigate extensive mathematical proofs using endpoints, intermediate junctions, proof references and open frontiers.
exclude_candidates: Navigation shortcuts are not proof steps or certified theorems.
Never mark an open problem solved from a route landmark.

profiles.name: Mathematical Research Frontier
profiles.summary: Organize ongoing mathematical research, hypotheses, failed attempts and external verification routes.
profiles.situational_schema: Hypotheses and proof obligations branch into experiments and verification evidence.
boundaries: Unverified hypotheses remain candidates.
Software tests do not mathematically certify claims.

scope_guidance.purpose: Organize ongoing mathematical research, hypotheses, failed attempts and external verification routes.
exclude_candidates: Unverified hypotheses remain candidates.
Software tests do not mathematically certify claims.

profiles.name: Individual School Follow-Up
profiles.summary: Maintain an individually restricted educational record with changes, interventions and accountable decisions.
profiles.situational_schema: Casefile links student history to assessments, supports, decisions and dates.
boundaries: Personal education records are sensitive; no real student data belong in a public template.
A school dossier does not itself decide placement or assessment.

scope_guidance.purpose: Maintain an individually restricted educational record with changes, interventions and accountable decisions.
exclude_candidates: Personal education records are sensitive; no real student data belong in a public template.
A school dossier does not itself decide placement or assessment.

profiles.name: Individual Medical Follow-Up
profiles.summary: Organize longitudinal patient records and clinical events with strict source and access boundaries.
profiles.situational_schema: Care episodes connect observations, decisions, documents and reviews without automated care delivery.
boundaries: Clinical decisions require qualified human authority.
Do not populate public templates with identifiable patient information.

scope_guidance.purpose: Organize longitudinal patient records and clinical events with strict source and access boundaries.
exclude_candidates: Clinical decisions require qualified human authority.
Do not populate public templates with identifiable patient information.

profiles.name: Civic / Administrative Individual Casefile
profiles.summary: Track administrative cases and documentary decisions over time under explicit jurisdiction and authority.
profiles.situational_schema: A person-specific administrative case connects applications, notices, dates and decision records.
boundaries: An administrative rule summary is not a legally binding decision.
Personal civil records require statutory or otherwise lawful authorization.

scope_guidance.purpose: Track administrative cases and documentary decisions over time under explicit jurisdiction and authority.
exclude_candidates: An administrative rule summary is not a legally binding decision.
Personal civil records require statutory or otherwise lawful authorization.

profiles.name: Vehicle Fault Diagnosis
profiles.summary: Diagnose vehicle failures using multiplex system topology, observations and testable hypotheses.
profiles.situational_schema: Diagnostic hub ties symptoms and test points to causal candidate paths and observed states.
boundaries: Generic examples do not replace OEM-specific repair or safety instructions.
Do not perform vehicle interventions without qualified authorization and risk controls.

scope_guidance.purpose: Diagnose vehicle failures using multiplex system topology, observations and testable hypotheses.
exclude_candidates: Generic examples do not replace OEM-specific repair or safety instructions.
Do not perform vehicle interventions without qualified authorization and risk controls.

profiles.name: Police Operations Protocols
profiles.summary: Organize versioned law-enforcement procedures, authorizations and exception pathways.
profiles.situational_schema: A branching process identifies authorized roles, conditions and external event logging.
boundaries: Descriptive procedures are not authorization for policing actions.
Local law and supervised policy control all interventions.

scope_guidance.purpose: Organize versioned law-enforcement procedures, authorizations and exception pathways.
exclude_candidates: Descriptive procedures are not authorization for policing actions.
Local law and supervised policy control all interventions.

profiles.name: Hospital Operations Protocols
profiles.summary: Structure institutional care workflows and operational procedures with exceptions, roles and audit.
profiles.situational_schema: Conditional workflow links roles, resources, escalation and external history.
boundaries: No protocol profile gives permission for clinical action.
Local clinical governance must approve actual implementation.

scope_guidance.purpose: Structure institutional care workflows and operational procedures with exceptions, roles and audit.
exclude_candidates: No protocol profile gives permission for clinical action.
Local clinical governance must approve actual implementation.

profiles.name: Medical Knowledge Orchestration
profiles.summary: Design knowledge-state interfaces for independent clinical knowledge and diagnostic pathway software.
profiles.situational_schema: Application orchestrates independent knowledge bases and adapters, with no inherited clinical authority.
boundaries: The independent MediKristal platform is not a single Kristal.
Reference software does not claim clinical validity or regulatory clearance.

scope_guidance.purpose: Design knowledge-state interfaces for independent clinical knowledge and diagnostic pathway software.
exclude_candidates: The independent MediKristal platform is not a single Kristal.
Reference software does not claim clinical validity or regulatory clearance.

profiles.name: School System and Rules Mapping
profiles.summary: Map school sectors, cycles, transitions, regulations and temporally applicable conditions.
profiles.situational_schema: Institutions, paths and rule layers connect through dated transitions and jurisdiction labels.
boundaries: A knowledge model cannot make actual admission or equivalence decisions.
Different educational institutions can apply narrower rules.

scope_guidance.purpose: Map school sectors, cycles, transitions, regulations and temporally applicable conditions.
exclude_candidates: A knowledge model cannot make actual admission or equivalence decisions.
Different educational institutions can apply narrower rules.

profiles.name: Multi-Purpose Semantic Reference
profiles.summary: Reuse a sourced semantic reference across teaching, museum, research and other readers.
profiles.situational_schema: One primary source reference feeds distinct projections without taking over each reader.
boundaries: Audience-specific views do not rewrite the common source reference.
Creative or educational interpretation is not original evidence.

scope_guidance.purpose: Reuse a sourced semantic reference across teaching, museum, research and other readers.
exclude_candidates: Audience-specific views do not rewrite the common source reference.
Creative or educational interpretation is not original evidence.

profiles.name: Attributed Testimony and Inquiry
profiles.summary: Document statements and accounts without treating their claims as established conclusions.
profiles.situational_schema: Attributed statements attach to a restricted dossier and dated revisions.
boundaries: Testimony is not a finding of fact.
Disclosure and access require independent authorization.

scope_guidance.purpose: Document statements and accounts without treating their claims as established conclusions.
exclude_candidates: Testimony is not a finding of fact.
Disclosure and access require independent authorization.
